r4-quality.imperative: Does the diagnosis meet inherited project/section rules (verify-seam-against-source, fail-visibly, py launcher, physics_region_no_evo_import)? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r8-status-set.imperative: Confirm from source the fit_status valid set = {ok, no_laps, no_accel_samples, error} and that fit_store.py:34 comment is stale. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r8-status-set.finding: Confirmed from source. session_fit.py is the only FitRecord producer; fit_status assigned at exactly 2 sites: record_from_params (:79, 'ok') and _err (:215, takes status arg). _err is called with no_laps (:241,:285), no_accel_samples (:312, from ValueError startswith 'no_accel_samples' mapped at :310-312), and error (:314 ValueError catch-all, :317 Exception catch-all). Valid set = {ok, no_laps, no_accel_samples, error} CONFIRMED. fit_store.py:34 reads '# "ok" | "error" | "no_laps"' — omits no_accel_samples -> STALE, confirmed.

r9-recover-skip-boundary.title: Confirm recover-vs-skip boundary evidence-backed
r9-recover-skip-boundary.imperative: Confirm the recover-vs-skip boundary is evidence-backed: recoverable iff both streams time-overlap in flying-lap windows (14/15); skip iff a required stream empty session-wide (Saudi DEV). Record pass/fail with a finding.
r9-recover-skip-boundary.finding: Boundary is evidence-backed and self-consistent. RECOVER side: the 14/15 cases that overlap in the flying-lap windows are precisely the ones that now return ok — I directly confirmed 3 of them (Japan PIA, Azerbaijan GAS recovered-interleaved; plus NoneType Bahrain ALO/Canada HUL) all return ok with healthy n_samp, which IS the recovery. SKIP side: Saudi DEV has spd N=0 session-wide (independently confirmed), overlap 0.0s -> genuinely unfittable, window-widening cannot help. Boundary 'recoverable iff both streams time-overlap in windows; skip iff a required stream empty session-wide' holds. Note (non-blocking): I re-derived the overlap numbers only for Saudi DEV directly; the other 14 rows of the §4 table I did not recompute, but their ok-status (sampled) is the stronger downstream proof of recovery.
